data.description:
We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join Pathify’s Australian engineering team.

You’ll work across our front end and back end stack, primarily using Python/Django, Angular and TypeScript, as well as emerging AI capabilities including agent workflows built on foundation models such as Gemini.

This is a senior individual contributor role. You’ll be expected to take ownership of complex and sometimes ambiguous engineering problems, determine the right technical approach, and deliver high-quality solutions from design through to production.
data.key_responsibilities:
• Own the design and delivery of significant features and technical initiatives across your team’s domain
  • Translate product requirements and ambiguous problems into pragmatic, scalable technical solutions
  • Make sound architectural and implementation decisions, balancing quality, speed, maintainability and customer impact
  • Build and maintain robust applications using Python/Django, Angular and TypeScript
  • Work closely with Product, Design and other engineers to shape technical specifications and delivery plans
  • Take responsibility for code quality, testing, debugging, deployment and ongoing operation of the software you build
  • Improve existing systems and identify opportunities to simplify, modernise or strengthen our codebase
  • Provide thoughtful code reviews and technical guidance to other engineers
  • Mentor and support less experienced engineers and contribute to raising engineering standards across the team
  • Explore and apply new technologies, including foundation models and agent-based workflows, where they can meaningfully improve our products
data.skills_knowledge_expertise:
• 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated capability
  • Strong experience building modern web applications across both backend and frontend
  • Proficiency in Python and Django — or deep expertise in another Python web framework with the ability to become productive in Django quickly
  • Strong JavaScript and TypeScript skills
  • Expertise with a modern frontend framework; Angular experience is strongly preferred
  • Experience working with foundation models or AI-enabled applications; Gemini experience is an advantage
  • Experience designing and developing RESTful APIs; Django REST Framework experience is preferred
  • Strong knowledge of relational databases, ideally PostgreSQL
  • Solid understanding of software design principles, data structures and common architectural patterns
  • Strong Git and modern software-development workflow experience
  • The ability to independently work through complex problems and make good technical decisions without needing detailed direction
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to explain technical trade-offs clearly
  • A track record of helping other engineers improve through mentoring, code review or technical leadership
  • A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience
  • Unrestricted working rights in Australia

data.description:
The Senior Customer Success Engineer (SCSE) is a hybrid, Swiss army knife role primarily responsible for providing high-quality, comprehensive technical expertise to colleges and universities for the Pathify platform. As Pathify continues scaling across the globe, they will join the global support team to provide 24/7 problem solving to Pathify’s growing customer base. Reporting to the Global Support Manager based in the US, this is a founding role in the APAC region with outstanding growth opportunities in either Customer Success or Sales.

Once onboarded and trained in support, responsibilities will include partnering with Sales to support pre-sales opportunities, and the scoping and delivery of implementations in-region. Meeting via Zoom or on-site with prospects and customers, the SCSE will support sales in winning new business, planning and orchestrating implementation projects, and hands-on-keyboard work helping universities launch Pathify enterprise-wide.

In this dynamic role, the SCSE must demonstrate exceptional customer service and troubleshooting skills along with a high degree of adaptability and flexibility. A passion for problem-solving, technology and helping others is essential to promote customer acquisition, success and expansion.
data.key_responsibilities:
Essential Functions

Diagnose, debug, and resolve complex application, integration, and data issues escalated beyond Tier 2.
  • Own the troubleshooting of SAML SSO configurations and API-driven integrations for live customers.
  • Serve as implementation lead for newly signed institutions in-territory, owning functional and adoption consulting alongside the technical configuration throughout.
  • For key opportunities, provide technical sales support in conjunction with regional Account Executives.
  • Read and interpret JavaScript, scripting languages, and system logs to pinpoint the root cause of unexpected platform behavior.
  • Diagnose authentication flows, API calls, and system interoperability challenges, teaching colleagues your approach as you go.
  • Manage and validate complex file provisioning workflows, including structured data files (CSV, JSON, XML) and secure automated transfers via SFTP.
  • Provide first-line technical coverage during Australian and New Zealand business hours, serving as the in-region escalation point for regional customers.
  • Participate in the global rotation providing engineering-level response for critical customer-reported issues
data.skills_knowledge_expertise:
Competencies


  • A proven ability to “hold the room” with senior university leaders, including strong presentation and public speaking proficiency.
  • Robust problem-solving, analytical, and decision-making skills, with the ability to take appropriate action independently.
  • Proven success in customer-facing roles such as technical support, implementation, solutions consulting, or technical account management.
  • Project management skills, including the ability to manage client onboarding timelines, run kickoff meetings, and manage customer expectations.
  • Excellent listening skills and the ability to communicate effectively, both orally and in writing, with various technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong presentation skills geared around functional and technical training.
  • Ability to master multiple platforms rapidly and adapt to frequent product deployments and changing tech stacks.
  • Skilled at working effectively across teams, including product owners, developers, and account managers to champion user needs while respecting engineering constraints.
  • Creativity in thinking outside the box to present innovative ideas and solutions to colleagues and customers.
  • A strong drive to achieve beyond what is expected, with a demonstrated desire for continuous learning and improvement.
  • An ability to operate independently without managerial support outside standard US business hours.

Education, Experience, and Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in high-tier technical support, application support, sales engineering, implementation consulting, or a junior engineering role within a SaaS environment
  • Required proficiency in reading, writing, or debugging JavaScript or other scripting languages to parse data and troubleshoot behaviors.
  • Strong technical background in User Provisioning and manual validation or manipulation of JSON, XML, and CSV files.
  • Ability to configure and troubleshoot SAML SSO (such as Okta, Azure AD, or Shibboleth) alongside a strong grasp of web network protocols.
  • Prior experience in the Ed Tech/LMS sector or professional experience in higher education is a plus.
  • Previous experience working in a fast-paced start-up environment is preferred.
  • Must reside in Australia
  • Must be authorized to work in Australia
  • Must be able to travel within Australia
  • Ability to travel domestically frequently and internationally once per year

data.benefits:
At Pathify, we’re obsessed with improving the student experience—but we know we can’t do that if our own team’s experience isn't top-tier. We don't just offer "perks"; we offer a safety net and a launchpad so you can do your best work without sweating the small (or big) stuff.

Here’s a look at how we take care of our own:

Health & Harmony 🌿

We want you feeling your best, whether you're at your desk or out exploring the world.

Comprehensive Coverage: Robust Health, Dental, and Vision insurance to keep you and your family "high-def" and healthy.

Tax-Smart Savings: Choose between a Flexible Spending Account (FSA) or a Health Savings Account (HSA) to keep more of your paycheck where it belongs.

Peace of Mind: Life happens. Our Life Insurance policy ensures you and your loved ones are always protected.

Time to Recharge: We believe in unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO) that you actually use. Whether it's a beach, a mountain, or a couch, go find your happy place.

Growing Families: Our Parental Leave policy gives you the time you need to bond with your newest family member without the stress of "checking in."

Wealth & Wisdom 💰

We’re invested in your future just as much as you are.

Future-Proofing: Our 401(k) plan helps you build your nest egg, and our Company Match means we’re literally putting our money where our mouth is to help you retire in style.

Never Stop Learning: We’re in EdTech, after all! Our Student Loan Reimbursement program helps you level up your skills, whether it's a certification or a new degree.

The Pathify Lifestyle 🏠

Since we’re a modern team, we make sure your daily "office" life is actually enjoyable.

Home Office Stipend: We’ll help you deck out your workspace. Whether you need an ergonomic chair or a second monitor, we’ve got your back (literally).

Wellness & Mental Health (Bonus!): Access to an Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and mental health resources, because your brain is your most important asset.

The Bottom Line: We’re building the future of higher education, and we want you to have a blast while doing it. If you’re looking for a place that treats you like a human first and an employee second, you’ve found it.

Compensation:
$100,000 - $125,000 / year OTE
$60-80K Base + Commissions
data.description: The Account Manager for SMB is a high-paced, activity-driven sales role focused on driving Gross Retention Rate (GDR) and Net Retention Rate (NDR) across a book of business of at least 45 SMB higher education accounts. This position requires high-volume daily outreach, quantifiable performance tracking, and fast-paced commercial execution. The AM owns contract renewals, upsells, and cross-selling new Pathify modules and features, while working closely with Customer Success to swiftly address and resolve technical support issues for customers.
data.key_responsibilities:
Essential Functions:
  • Maintain high daily/weekly outreach activity to manage a book of business of at least 45 SMB customer accounts
  • Drive key retention and growth metrics, targeting specific Gross Dollar Retention (GDR) and Net Dollar Retention (NDR) goals
  • Manage full renewal cycles, ensuring high customer retention across all assigned SMB institutions
  • Identify and close expansion opportunities by cross-selling new Pathify features, add-ons, and modules
  • Collaborate closely with Customer Success and Support teams to route, monitor, and resolve technical support issues rapidly
  • Conduct regular account check-ins and run high-frequency product discovery calls to showcase feature enhancements
  • Track quantifiable KPIs including daily call/email volume, demo completion rates, pipeline velocity, and renewal timelines
  • Deliver quick, value-driven demonstrations of new Pathify capabilities tailored to SMB client needs
  • Maintain meticulous CRM records, logging all daily activities, renewal statuses, and upsell pipeline updates in real time
  • Research trends in Higher Education and Technology  and discover new opportunities to increase sales
  • Log activities and update pipeline metrics daily
  • Maintain a strong understanding of the Pathify platform, especially focusing on best practices and valuable use cases
  • Other duties as assigned
data.skills_knowledge_expertise:
• High-energy, activity-driven mindset with strong organization and time management skills
  • Capacity to use initiative and independent judgment appropriately while making decisions quickly and effectively
  • Rapid mastery of the technology
  • Willingness to motivate colleagues and teams to work towards shared sales targets and strategies
  • Comfortable with quantifiable metrics, daily call/activity expectations, and aggressive retention targets
  • Entrepreneurial spirit, intellectual curiosity, and persuasive confidence 
  • Demonstrated desire for continuous learning and improvement
  • Trust, positivity, patience, and a desire to learn and have fun
  • Ability to use standard office equipment, computer equipment and software, including word processing, database management, spreadsheet applications, and electronic mail

  • 2-3 years of account management in a SaaS environment, or equivalent experience in a similar role
  • Evidence of consistent above quota production in a similar role
  • Ability to travel occasionally
  • Higher Ed tech experience a plus
  • Start-up professional experience a plus

data.description: Pathify is seeking a high-performing, commercially minded Account Manager to drive customer retention, strategic growth, and account expansion across our assigned portfolio of higher education partners. In this role, you will quarterback post-contract revenue strategy, managing executive-level relationships across complex institutional ecosystems. You will serve as the commercial trusted advisor to executive stakeholders—including CIOs, Vice Presidents, and Deans—championing platform value, expanding our multi-product footprint, and safeguarding net revenue retention (NRR).
data.key_responsibilities:
Essential Functions:
  • Revenue Expansion & Account Strategy: Formulate and execute multi-year account plans for a dedicated portfolio of 30+ higher education institutions. Identify upsell, cross-sell, and platform adoption opportunities to consistently expand Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) and pipeline.

  • Executive Relationship Architecture: Build deep, trust-based relationships with C-suite leaders (CIOs, VPs of IT/Student Affairs) and cross-departmental stakeholders across complex higher ed decision-making bodies.

  • Commercial Leadership & Renewals: Lead contract renegotiations, renewals, and expansion agreements. Own the end-to-end commercial lifecycle while proactively mitigating churn risk.

  • Consultative Value Selling & Demos: Deliver compelling, value-driven presentations and tailored platform demonstrations that align Pathify’s capabilities with institutional strategic priorities and ROI metrics.

  • Cross-Functional Quarterbacking: Lead cross-functional alignment across Customer Success, Product, Solutions Architecture, and Leadership to deliver seamless executive engagements, solution delivery, and business reviews.

  • Pipeline & Forecast Hygiene: Maintain precise, data-driven pipeline management and quarterly sales plans within Salesforce, utilizing structured sales frameworks to drive predictable execution.

  • Support Oriented: Partner with Pathify’s Customer Success, Product and IT teams to help identify, prioritize and solve technical support issues.
data.skills_knowledge_expertise:
• Mastery of value-based or consultative sales methodologies (e.g., MEDDPICC, Challenger, Consultative, GAP, or Solution Selling)
  • Highly skilled in contract negotiation, account planning, risk mitigation, and navigating complex procurement/budget cycles in higher education
  • High degree of intellectual curiosity, strategic independence, and background thriving in high-growth, venture-backed startup environments
  • Proficiency in leveraging modern revenue tech stacks, specifically Salesforce, AI Tools, and advanced sales engagement platforms
  • A numbers driven mentality, with a strong desire for quantifiable, mutual accountability for activity, and time management.
  • A prospecting-first mindset.  Account Managers are fully responsible for building and closing cross-sell pipeline.

  • 5+ years of Enterprise SaaS Sales / Account Management experience required, with a proven track record managing complex B2B or EdTech accounts
  • Higher Education technology experience—specifically selling into C-suite stakeholders—is strongly preferred
  • Documented history of exceeding quota targets in retention and revenue expansion roles (top-decile performance)
  • Proven experience managing a book of business of 30+ higher education institutions

  • Location: Greater Denver, CO area preferred (hybrid/remote)
  • Willingness to travel occasionally for key client business reviews, executive briefings, and industry conferences

  • Startup experience preferred
